description_en: Creates a subscription instance. This operation can be replaced by RunInstances. No new features will be added to CreateInstance
description_zh: 调用CreateInstance创建一台预付费实例。此接口可用RunInstances替代，后续CreateInstance不再迭代新功能
kebab_example: aliyun ens create-instance --instance-type ens.se1.tiny --ens-region-id cn-hangzhou --period 12 --quantity 1 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateInstance

parameters.help_en:
The instance type.

For details about instance types, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/66124.html
parameters.help_zh:
实例规格。

实例规格详情请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/66124.html
parameters.name: instance_type

parameters.help_en: The region ID
parameters.help_zh: 地域
parameters.name: ens_region_id

parameters.help_en:
The password of the instance.

The password must be 8 to 30 characters in length and must contain at least three of the following character types: uppercase letters, lowercase letters, digits, and special characters. The following special characters are supported: ```()`~!@#$%^&*-_+=|{}[]:;'<>,.?/```
parameters.help_zh:
实例的密码。

长度为8至30个字符，必须同时包含大小写英文字母、数字和特殊符号中的三类字符。可以设置以下特殊符号：```()`~!@#$%^&*-_+=|{}[]:;'<>,.?/```
parameters.name: password

parameters.help_en: The subscription duration. Valid values: 1 to 9 and 12. Unit: months
parameters.help_zh: 购买资源的时长，取值范围：1~9和12，单位：月
parameters.name: period

parameters.help_en: The ID of the image that is used to start the instance
parameters.help_zh: 镜像文件ID，启动实例时选择的镜像资源
parameters.name: image_id

parameters.help_en: The size of the system cloud disk. Unit: GiB. The value must be a multiple of 10 and cannot be smaller than the image size. For the valid range, refer to the SystemDiskMinSize and SystemDiskMaxSize values returned by DescribeAvailableResourceInfo. 20 GiB and 40 GiB are common configurations and do not indicate that only these two values are supported
parameters.help_zh: 系统盘大小，单位：GiB。取值须为 10 的倍数且不能小于镜像大小；有效范围请以 DescribeAvailableResourceInfo 返回的 SystemDiskMinSize 和 SystemDiskMaxSize 为准。20 GiB 和 40 GiB 是常用配置，不表示仅支持这两个值
parameters.name: system_disk_size

parameters.help_en: The number of instances
parameters.help_zh: 实例数量
parameters.name: quantity

parameters.help_en: The size of the first data cloud disk. Unit: GiB. The size must be at least 20 GiB and a multiple of 10
parameters.help_zh: 第一块数据盘的容量大小，单位为GiB，容量至少为20 GiB且为10的倍数
parameters.name: data_disk_1_size

parameters.help_en:
This parameter is required when you create an instance for the first time. If you already have instance resources, the existing billing method is used by default. Valid values:

BandwidthByDay: daily peak bandwidth.

95BandwidthByMonth: monthly 95th percentile bandwidth
parameters.help_zh:
如果您第一次创建该参数为必传。如果已有实例资源，则默认按照已存在的计费方式。取值：

BandwidthByDay：日峰值带宽。

95BandwidthByMonth：月95峰值带宽
parameters.name: internet_charge_type

parameters.help_en: The auto-renewal period. This parameter is required when AutoRenew is set to True. Valid values: 1 to 12. Unit: months
parameters.help_zh: 每次自动续费的时长，当参数AutoRenew取值True时为必填。取值：1~12，单位：月
parameters.name: auto_renew_period

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable auto-renewal. Valid values: True | False (default)
parameters.help_zh: 是否要自动续费。取值：True|False（默认值）
parameters.name: auto_renew

parameters.help_en:
The IP type. Valid values:

ipv4 (default): IPv4.

ipv6: IPv6.

ipv4Andipv6: IPv4 and IPv6
parameters.help_zh:
IP类型。取值：

ipv4（默认值）：IPv4。

ipv6：IPv6。

ipv4Andipv6：IPv4和IPv6
parameters.name: ip_type

parameters.help_en: The name of the key pair. Only a single name is supported
parameters.help_zh: 密钥对名称。仅支持传单个名称
parameters.name: key_pair_name

parameters.example: #!/bin/sh  echo "Hello World.  The time is now $(date -R)!" | tee /home/output.txt
parameters.help_en:
The custom data. The data must start with `#!`. The maximum length is 256 characters and the maximum size is 16 KB. Only custom data scripts are supported. InstanceMetaData rendering is not supported.


You can pass in custom data that is Base64-encoded. When you call the API to initiate a request, the custom data you specify is not encrypted. Do not pass in confidential information such as passwords and private keys in plaintext. If you need to pass in passwords or private keys, encrypt the content first and then Base64-encode it before passing it in. Decrypt the content in the same way inside the instance.

For more information, see Data format (https://cloudinit.readthedocs.io/en/latest/topics/format.html)
parameters.help_zh:
自定义数据，以`#!`开头。目前，最长支持256字符，最大支持16 KB。传参内容仅支持自定义数据Script，不支持InstanceMetaData渲染。


您可传入自定义数据。数据以Base64的方式编码。调用API发起请求时，不会加密您设置的自定义数据，建议您不要以明文方式传入机密的信息，例如：密码和私钥等。如果需要传入密码和私钥等内容，请您对内容进行加密后，然后以Base64的方式编码后再传入。在实例内部以同样的方式反解密。

详情请参见数据格式 (https://cloudinit.readthedocs.io/en/latest/topics/format.html)
parameters.name: user_data

parameters.help_en: The vSwitch ID
parameters.help_zh: 交换机ID
parameters.name: vswitch_id

parameters.help_en: The private IP address. If you specify a private IP address, you must also specify the VSwitchId parameter. The vSwitch must be created in advance. Otherwise, an error is returned
parameters.help_zh:
内网地址。
如果传了内网地址，则vSwitch必传。vSwitch需要先创建好，否则会报错
parameters.name: private_ip_address

parameters.help_en: The payment method. Currently, this is a fixed value of Subscription (subscription instance). Modification is not supported
parameters.help_zh: 支付方式。目前为固定值Subscription：预付费实例，暂不支持修改
parameters.name: payment_type

parameters.help_en:
The name of the instance. Naming conventions:

The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length and can contain letters and Chinese characters.
The name must start with an uppercase letter, a lowercase letter, or a Chinese character. It cannot start with http:// or https://.
The name can contain digits, colons (:), underscores (_), periods (.), or hyphens (-).

If this parameter is not specified, the default value is the InstanceId of the instance
parameters.help_zh:
实例的名称。命名规则如下所示：

长度为2~128个英文或中文字符。
必须以大小字母或中文开头，不能以http://和https://开头。
可以包含数字、半角冒号（:）、下划线（_）、英文句号（.）或者连字符（-）。

如果没有指定该参数，默认值为实例的InstanceId
parameters.name: instance_name

parameters.help_en:
The hostname of the instance.
General naming conventions: Periods (.) and hyphens (-) cannot be used as the first or last character and cannot be used consecutively.

Specific naming conventions:
Windows instances: The hostname must be 2 to 15 characters in length. Periods (.) are not supported. The hostname cannot consist entirely of digits. Uppercase letters, lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens (-) are allowed.
Other instances (such as Linux): The hostname must be 2 to 64 characters in length. Multiple periods (.) are supported. Each segment separated by a period can contain uppercase letters, lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens (-)
parameters.help_zh:
云服务器的主机名。
通用命名规则：英文句号（.）和短横线（-）不能作为首尾字符，更不能连续使用。

具体实例命名规则如下：
Windows实例：字符长度为2~15，不支持英文句号（.），不能全是数字。允许大小写英文字母、数字和短横线（-）。
其他类型实例（Linux等）：字符长度为2~64，支持多个英文句号（.），英文句号之间为一段，每段允许大小写英文字母、数字和短横线（-）
parameters.name: host_name

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to add sequential suffixes to HostName and InstanceName. The sequential suffixes start from 001 and cannot exceed 999.

Example: LocalHost001, LocalHost002, MyInstance001, and MyInstance002.

Default value: false
parameters.help_zh:
是否为HostName和InstanceName添加有序后缀。有序后缀从001开始递增，最大不能超过999。

例如：LocalHost001，LocalHost002和MyInstance001，MyInstance002。

默认值：false
parameters.name: unique_suffix

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether a public IP address can be assigned to the specified instance. Valid values:

true (default): A public IP address can be assigned.
false: A public IP address cannot be assigned
parameters.help_zh:
公网IP是否可以分配给指定实例。取值：

true（默认值）：可以分配。
false：不可以分配
parameters.name: public_ip_identification

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to use the preset password of the image. Valid values:

true: The preset password of the image is used. The Password parameter must be empty, and you must make sure that the image has a preset password.
false: The preset password of the image is not used
parameters.help_zh:
是否使用镜像预设的密码。取值：

true：使用镜像预设的密码，且Password参数必须为空，同时您需要确保使用的镜像已经设置了密码。
false：不使用镜像预设的密码
parameters.name: password_inherit

Code.description_en:
The return code. A value of 0 indicates success.

If you call this API operation by using an SDK, the return type is Integer. If you call this API operation by using a common method or HTTP, the return type is String
Code.description_zh:
返回码，成功返回0。

如果您通过SDK方式调用该API会返回Integer类型，通用方式或者HTTP方式调用会返回字符串类型
